Coastal Waters Forecast
National Weather Service Honolulu HI
504 AM HST Fri Jul 24 2026

Hawaiian coastal waters within 40 nautical miles including the
Hawaiian Islands Humpback Whale National Marine Sanctuary.

PHZ100-250415-
504 AM HST Fri Jul 24 2026

.Synopsis for Hawaiian coastal waters...
High pressure far north of Hawaii will drift westward over the
next several days, leading to a slight decline in trade winds
during the weekend. Hurricane Fausto is forecast to weaken into a
tropical storm before it nears the islands Tuesday.
